capabilities: Collect notes, headings, and blocks as cards in a sidebar pane
Drag tabs and notes between the editor and the desk
Organize cards with colors, grouping, folding, and text or color filters
Create notes into an inbox folder and add existing inbox notes
Export desk cards onto a canvas
extras: The README warns that moving tabs onto the desk relies on undocumented Obsidian internals, so an Obsidian update could break that one feature until the plugin is updated; drag and drop also does not work on touch screens. A CSS snippet can override the maximum card height setting.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated scratch space to park notes or sections temporarily while working, without juggling tabs or losing your place.
summary: Sidebar pane that holds temporary cards of notes, headings, or blocks beside the note you are writing, with colors, grouping, filtering, and canvas export.
